plugins.name: gangway
plugins.description: Charts, diagrams, documents, decks and canvases on a real HTTPS URL on your own gangway server, in place of built-in artifacts; a quick place to put up new apps, with a database if they need one; and previews of every pull request in a GitHub repository.
